heading.title: Suits for Breach of the Contract

article.title: Damages for non-acceptance.
article.content: Where the buyer wrongfully neglects or refuses to accept and pay for the goods, the seller may sue him for damages for non-acceptance.
article.html:
56Damages for non-acceptance.

Section 56 · Chapter VI · page 14 of the Act

Where the buyer wrongfully neglects or refuses to accept and pay for the goods, the seller may sue him for damages for non-acceptance.
